references.title: Grants in AWS KMS - AWS Key Management Service
references.quote: If you try to use a grant before it fully propagates through the system, you might get an access denied error. A grant token lets you refer to the grant and use the grant permissions immediately.
references.supports: Nguyên nhân lỗi là eventual consistency; grant token cho phép dùng quyền ngay.

references.title: CreateGrant - AWS Key Management Service
references.quote: However, to use the permissions in the grant immediately, use the GrantToken that CreateGrant returns.
references.supports: Grant token là giá trị do CreateGrant trả về, dùng để có quyền ngay.

references.title: CreateGrant - AWS Key Management Service
references.quote: A friendly name for the grant. Use this value to prevent the unintended creation of duplicate grants when retrying this request.
references.supports: Name không phải grant token; chỉ dùng để idempotent khi retry.

references.title: CreateGrant - AWS Key Management Service
references.quote: The request was rejected because the specified grant token is not valid.
references.supports: Token tự đặt/không do KMS sinh ra bị từ chối.

references.title: Encrypt - AWS Key Management Service
references.quote: Use a grant token when your permission to call this operation comes from a new grant that has not yet achieved eventual consistency.
references.supports: Encrypt nhận GrantTokens để dùng quyền của grant mới tạo; payload 512 byte nằm trong giới hạn 4,096 byte của Encrypt (khóa đối xứng).

references.title: Encrypt - AWS Key Management Service
references.quote: Encrypts plaintext of up to 4,096 bytes using a KMS key.
references.supports: Payload 512 byte nằm trong giới hạn của Encrypt, nên lỗi không liên quan kích thước dữ liệu mà do grant chưa lan truyền.
